page.overview:
Who is Aranessa Royce?

Lady is the head of the Sundered House of Royce, and the widow of Thjazi Fang. As an NPC, Aranessa is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Lady Aranessa is an elegant woman in her forties. When she attended the funeral of her husband Thjazi Fang, she wore a gown of gleaming green adorned with jewels. She carried her wedding ring with her despite not having been together with her husband for a long time. In the days after her husband's arrest and execution, followed by the attack against House Royce, the noblewoman had lost a lot of weight due to stress.

Despite her status as a noble lady, Aranessa is close to those she considers trustworthy, no matter who they are, and is in touch with her emotions to the point where she breaks protocol.

Lady Aranessa was born as the granddaughter of Lord Royce less than three decades after the end of the Shapers' War. When she was still a child she attended the wedding of Lord Otto Einfasen, arriving to Riesingürtle in a sky carriage. As she grew up, she became friends with Julien Davinos, the son of a vassal house, who was born when she was a teenager. Episode 2 Discussing Up To C4E18|1:02:30}}
